description: List a job's reviewer feedback reports (employer-only) with authoritative CONCERN-lane status counts plus recordedCount and assessment counts. Filters: status (or ALL), subject (a user id, or UNLINKED for legacy reports awaiting reconciliation), assessment (NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT includes legacy pre-assessment rows), lane (CONCERN|RECORDED; a concrete status or severity implies CONCERN and combined with lane=RECORDED is rejected), severity, reporter, search over the report body, createdFrom/createdTo ISO bounds, 1-based page. Requires job_feedback:read.

assessment.description: DEV-3168 balanced filter; NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT includes legacy rows.

lane.description: CONCERN = triage lifecycle rows; RECORDED = non-concern rows. RECORDED cannot combine with a concrete status or severity.

subject.description: A subject user id, or 'UNLINKED' for legacy unlinked reports.

name: opentrain_job_feedback_list
